title: Acceleration-compensated gravity, one iteration, hand-held only
hypothesis: Motion acceleration leaks into the 3 s gravity smoother (hand-held circular motion has periods of a few seconds); subtracting the smoother's own acceleration estimate before re-smoothing gravity reduces the tilt error (the -16 % tilt oracle of E56)
